proposed_capability: Add per-Sim motive schemas and bounded, operator-reviewed local outcome ranking for ordinary and occult Sims, reusing six-need and fun lane action IDs without emitting any gameplay input.
player_save_control_impact: Never selects a Sim type by inference; fails closed on unknown/missing motives, mismatched pack or patch, player activity and unobserved interaction IDs. No game, saves, OS, user folder, background daemon or per-frame polling effects.
expected_outcome: One versioned typed motive/action catalog for six human needs and occult overrides (vampire, mermaid, fairy, servo) plus compatible standard sets and explicit unknown templates; exact observed motive keys and pack context; measurable per-profile per-patch opt-in reviewed helpful/harmful updates with replay guards and a deterministic no-effect advisory.
negative_tests: Absent/unknown occult does not inherit human needs
Motive count and numeric validation fail closed
Unknown or unobserved actions cannot recommend
Learning replay, bad patch or wrong profile rejected
Harmful learned action demotes but never bypasses catalog
No disk writes, game input or auto-listener
rollback_path: Revert the isolated policy and catalog commit. No runtime installation, save migration, tuning mutation or profile auto-write.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact installed game build, packs, actual occult menu labels/availability and EA tuning identifiers require local read-only evidence
BI-002 hunger 5+5 and rollback remain active and independently unproven
Host integration as native EA tuning/script is a separately authorized, version-pinned successor
